British system: completion of Year 13 / Grade 12, with a UAE Ministry of Education equivalency certificate. CUD gives no minimum grade for this programme. English: no test needed if your school taught in English (official proof) or, on the UAE Advanced Track, with 80% in English; otherwise IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61. All admitted students take a Maths placement test unless they have 70% in UAE high-school Maths or SAT Math 450.

IB: assessed under UAE Ministry of Education equivalency rules. CUD gives no minimum score for this programme. English: no test needed if your school taught in English (official proof) or, on the UAE Advanced Track, with 80% in English; otherwise IELTS Academic 5.0 / TOEFL iBT 61. All admitted students take a Maths placement test unless they have 70% in UAE high-school Maths or SAT Math 450.

Mechanical Engineering: three A-Levels including at least two of Maths, Chemistry, Physics; typical range A*A*A to AAA. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

Science: three A-Levels including Maths and one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics; Computer Sciences group typical range A*AA to ABB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
